subject.title: fix(ci): pin corrected Kova scenario calibration

question: Does the newer Kova revision already pinned on current main include the correction from openclaw/Kova pull request 74, making this PR unnecessary or requiring its pin to be refreshed?
rationale: The submitted SHA is correct relative to the PR base, but current main has advanced to a later Kova SHA; only the release-workflow owner should select the canonical revision after confirming upstream ancestry and calibration behavior.

options.title: Refresh to newest corrected pin
options.body: Confirm the current-main Kova revision contains the correction, update or close this branch accordingly, and retain the newest tested immutable revision.

options.title: Retain this exact pin
options.body: Use revision 678ff0b764b8786c2e436efbe4efac7d9aac10f8 only if the newer main revision lacks or regresses the approved calibration.

recommendation.title: Refresh to newest corrected pin
recommendation.body: Confirm the current-main Kova revision contains the correction, update or close this branch accordingly, and retain the newest tested immutable revision.

likelyOwner.reason: They coordinated the upstream correction and this OpenClaw pin, so they can most directly verify revision ancestry and scenario behavior.
